articles.title: CFTC backs blockchain-based derivatives infrastructure
articles.summary: The CFTC approved Backpack and tZERO to run regulated derivatives exchanges and clearinghouses that use blockchain to execute and settle trades. Chair Michael Selig called it a milestone showing a regulated pathway for blockchain-built market infrastructure. tZERO got its exchange approval last week, after an earlier clearing organization approval, and Backpack US President Mark Wetjen called its approvals a “really big deal.”

articles.title: Standard Chartered says Japan's bond tokenization could help drive RWAs to $2 trillion
articles.summary: Tokenizing Japanese government bonds could help the tokenized real-world asset market grow from about $45B to the bank's $2T forecast by the end of 2028, which so far relied mainly on tokenized money market funds and equities at $750B each. Most tokenized government debt is short-term, with about $13B in US T-bills and under $1B elsewhere.

articles.title: MEGA's $30M Bet on Inference Markets
articles.summary: MegaETH rebranded as MEGA and committed $30M from treasury to an inference market launching in December, after co-founder Shuyao Kong acknowledged the chain found no PMF despite TVL dropping from a $245M May peak to under $10M. The product targets a "supply paradox" where buyers overpay for familiar inference providers running identical open models, addressed via a "Purified Intelligence" verification layer, though the approach is undefined: Antseed already does fingerprinting verification, TEE-sealed hardware certifies model runs, and Anthropic open-sourced cryptographic model proofs, yet MEGA's paper names all three without committing to one. MEGA's clearest potential differentiation lies in prompt privacy and forward capacity markets where buyers reserve specific model/volume/performance windows and trade those reservations, pricing future model output rather than GPU hours as ICE's planned GPU futures do.

articles.title: Korean fintech Toss to launch in-app non-custodial crypto wallet
articles.summary: Toss Coin Wallet may let any Toss user create a non-custodial wallet from the app's asset menu with no extra eligibility requirements, to send, receive, and check balances of ETH, USDT, and USDC, with contact-based transfers. It is Toss' first consumer crypto product, and it is considering applying for a VASP license to support stablecoin payments on its terminals. It has partnered with Solana Foundation and Circle, and has over 30M cumulative users, about 60% of South Korea's population.

articles.title: Wintermute's $10M/Year Hyperliquid Latency Edge
articles.summary: Wintermute spends about $10M per year ($26,000/day) to hold 76% of Hyperliquid's gossip priority auction slots, securing a 50-60ms latency edge in a protocol that re-auctions queue priority every three minutes. That head start lets the firm cancel orders before large incoming trades hit, adjust quotes toward incoming flow, and cross-venue hedge on Binance before Hyperliquid prices reprice, a set of strategies that underpins $227M in lifetime platform profits and $18.8M over the past 30 days. Full access requires a direct Foundation node connection gated at ~0.5% of network maker volume plus 10,000 HYPE staked (~$18.9M), locking smaller market makers out and forcing them to widen spreads or exit altcoin books, with the cost ultimately absorbed by retail traders.

articles.title: Everyone Is Approaching Agentic Commerce Wrong
articles.summary: Agentic commerce benchmarks expose a structural breakdown: Walmart's ChatGPT-driven conversion ran at one-third of walmart.com's rate, only 7% of tested agent checkouts completed, and Visa's own benchmark found agents succeeded at assigned tasks just 57% of the time. Former Meta payments engineer Vignesh Sreedhar traced the root cause to missing incentive alignment, the same gap that plagued credit cards before Dee Hock designed Visa's interchange model in 1966, where 86% of fees return to cardholders as rewards and every network participant has a self-interested reason to grow legitimate volume. Stored-value models (Stripe Link Balance and Rain Agent Vaults) are the closest current approximation because they give agents an economic stake, but they cut issuers out of interchange revenue. Without treating agent companies as a fifth economic party in payment networks, on par with issuers and acquirers, the volume growth agentic commerce promises will not materialize.

articles.title: User-Generated Markets, Take Two
articles.summary: Most prediction market volume concentrates in a fraction of markets, with 70% of Polymarket's closed markets clearing under $10K and only 35% of Kalshi's 7.6M combo tickers seeing any activity, yet no major venue lets users create markets. Augur (2018) demonstrated the demand but failed on four axes: bonds too cheap to deter abuse, vague resolution rules exploited for invalid-market plays, wash trading cost only gas, and dispute resolution required a 60-day fork process. XO Market, on mainnet since November 2025, addresses each failure with a mandatory $10 seed order, AI rule pre-screening, liquidity rewards gated on real trading interest, and 20% fee rebates to creators of active markets, reporting $783M in cumulative notional volume across 3,000+ user-created markets after 12 months.

articles.title: Why Crypto Feels Miserable
articles.summary: ETH and SOL price declines erased roughly $350B in industry wealth since October 2024, while revenue grew only ~$8B, explaining why the sector feels depressed despite bullish macro signals like Hyperliquid's ICE partnership for onchain perpetuals and Treasury Secretary Bessent projecting stablecoins to $2T. With $26.6B in annual cash inflows, closing that $350B gap through revenue alone would require 35x growth, equal to 350 Hyperliquid-scale businesses, because crypto industry health tracks asset prices far more than operating revenue. Two recovery paths exist: revenue-generating tokens like HYPE accumulating at scale, or native asset appreciation requiring a greater than 60% BTC move when adjusted for ETF holders who do not recycle capital back into the ecosystem, with 2027/2028 as the projected recovery window.

articles.title: Coinbase Launches Bitcoin Children's Book
articles.summary: Coinbase released a limited-edition children's book on money and crypto, bundling $50 in bitcoin with each hard copy, timed one year after the US discontinued the penny.

articles.title: Solana Confidential Compute Goes Live
articles.summary: Solana Foundation launched Confidential Compute, a TEE-based feature enabling private AI inference and confidential smart contract execution onchain, targeting use cases like sovereign trading agents and autonomous DAOs.

articles.title: CZ denies Binance sold crypto as Bitcoin bounces from four-month low
articles.summary: Bitcoin fell to its lowest since July around $62,000 before recovering to about $64,910, down 14.2% on the week.

articles.title: DBS and JPMorgan launch instant tokenized deposit transfers
articles.summary: DBS Token Services and JPMorgan's Kinexys now interoperate, letting institutional clients move USD tokenized deposits 24/7 between the two markets.
